input.quote: 12.22 Notwithstanding any other provisions in this Paragraph 12, when the Equipped Capacity is expanded to six (6) times of Initial Equipped Capacity or three (3) years after the RFS date whichever comes first, any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding Teleglobe USA Inc. Searches for "compet", "restrict", "exclusiv" and "shall not" return no covenant limiting the businesses we may operate, the products we may buy or build, or our participation in other cable systems (Paragraph 11.2 expressly contemplates other cable systems using the same Terminal Stations). The only provisions using "restrictions" (Subparagraphs 12.20 and 12.22) are permissive and favour us, confirming that Parties may sell IRUs and make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions". Subparagraph 17.4 likewise binds the Terminal Parties not to impede Direct Access, which is a restraint on the counterparties, not on us. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer). Noted but not flagged: Subparagraphs 12.1 and 12.6–12.15 condition how Allocated Capacity itself may be used (carrier-only use, affiliate transfer conditions). These are internal asset-use rules of a jointly owned consortium cable, apply equally to all Parties, and are expressly relaxed under 12.15/12.20/12.22 — they are not a restraint on our wider business and so are not a NONCOMPETE deviation.
